leadText:
(Japanese: オレたちミュウ探偵団 We're the Mew Research Team) is a Pokémon manga published in the August 2005 issue of CoroCoro Special. It consists of 30 pages. The writer and artist is Seino Nana (せいの奈々).

The manga is about two boys playing Pokémon Red/Blue on their Game Boy, competing to be the first to .
